syllabusSource.title: Pharmacy Council of India, Education Regulations 2020 (ER-2020), D.Pharm second year, Pharmacy Law and Ethics ER20-26T (university copy of the PCI syllabus)

units.title: General principles of law, history and Acts related to drugs and pharmacy
Pharmacy Act, 1948 and Pharmacy Practice Regulations, 2015
Drugs and Cosmetics Act and Rules I: objectives, definitions, schedules, import and administration
Drugs and Cosmetics Act and Rules II: manufacture, schedules, sale, records and banned drugs
Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 and Poisons Act, 1919
Drugs and Magic Remedies Act, 1954 and Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960
NPPA, DPCO 2013, Pharmaceutical Policy 2002 and NLEM
FSSAI and food supplements, MTP Act and Clinical Establishments Act
CDSCO and IPC, good regulatory practices and medical devices
New drug development, clinical trials, BCS, ANDA/NDA, brands, patents and emergency use authorisation
Blood bank and Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules, 2016
Bioethics and ICMR guidelines, Consumer Protection Act and Disaster Management Act
